authorInfo.bio: Chauncey Jerome (1793–1868) was an American clockmaker and politician in the early 19th century. He made a fortune selling his clocks, and his business grew quickly. He was mayor of New Haven, Connecticut between 1854-1855. However, his company failed in 1856, and he died in poverty.

description: "History of the American Clock Business for the Past Sixty Years, and Life of Chauncey Jerome" written by Chauncey Jerome is a historical account likely composed during the late 19th century. The book recounts the evolution of clock manufacturing in the United States, particularly in Connecticut, through the lens of Jerome's own life and experiences in the industry.
